item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] MapQuest becomes America’s top iPhone app after rejecting ‘Lake America’ rename
item.description: MapQuest has surged to the top of the App Store after refusing to rename Lake Ontario “Lake America,” sparking a viral nostalgia-fueled comeback.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] North Carolina becomes first state to send mail ballots as confusion over voting rules persists
item.description: North Carolina will be the first state to mail ballots this election cycle, but uncertainty remains over potential changes to mail-in voting rules tied to President Donald Trump’s executive order.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Residents along MLK Street South in St. Pete ask for safety improvements
item.description: A local group is pushing for more safety improvements along a dangerous road in St. Pete. Residents said Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Street South needs some changes to increase safety.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: tropical storm] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tropical Storm Edouard brings heavy rain, flash flood threat to Texas
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard is continuing to dump heavy rain across Texas Wednesday morning after making landfall as a tropical storm, creating a threat for flash flooding across parts of the state.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 25 Years After 9/11: How the attacks revolutionized U.S. war planning at CENTCOM
item.description: While the public watched live broadcasts on the morning of September 11, 2001, trying to understand if a plane or jet had suffered a catastrophic mechanical failure, intelligence officers at U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) in Tampa already knew the truth.
